articles.title: Hackers Set Freezer Controls to 100°C, Then Lock Technicians Out of the System
articles.summary:

When a service technician tried to sign in to the cooling control system, his access was blocked. articles.title: 12-Year-Old NFS2ROOT Linux Flaw Let Hackers Take Full Control of Servers Without a Password
articles.summary:
A critical Linux kernel flaw called NFS2ROOT could let an attacker take full control of an unpatched Network File System (NFS) server without logging in. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-99362, affects the Linux kernel’s NFS server when NFSv4.1 or NFSv4.2 is enabled and an attacker can reach TCP port 2049. The affected code dates back […]

articles.title: New SYS010 Malware Uses Fake Facebook Ads to Steal Meta Business Accounts and Gmail Data
articles.summary:

The download delivers a working wallpaper app, but it also runs malware in the background. On selected computers, the malware forces browsers to install extensions that can steal session cookies and collect Facebook advertising […]

articles.title: Hackers Use Hidden Chrome Extension to Read Gmail Messages Without Stealing Passwords
articles.summary:

articles.title: 3,089 Telegram Job Posts Uncovered in Suspected Spy Recruitment Campaigns
articles.summary:

The account later promoted what looked like a part-time job with a U.S. environmental consultancy. The two offers helped researchers connect ordinary-looking gig ads to a wider set […]

articles.summary:
